instruction: A tall standing drinks cabinet with a stepped ziggurat crown and symmetrical sunburst inlay across its double doors. Rich lacquered ebony panels are framed by polished brass fluting and slender tapered legs tipped in gold. Its bold geometric lines and mirrored gloss capture the glamorous symmetry of 1920s deco design.
